minInvestment: $0 via consulate income/savings. Alt: Real estate ≥$450k or Investment ≥$225k.
timeToCitizenship: 5 years (standard). 2 years with Mexican family or if Latin American/Spanish.
minimumPresence: No fixed annual days. Must be in Mexico ~4 weeks for card issuance and return for renewals.
requirements: Consulate visa sticker (valid 6 months, single entry) → INM card in Mexico within 30 days

TR via income: UMA-based formula (consulates adopted UMA from July 2025). Approximate ~USD 4,100-4,400/mo in 2025-2026 — BUT varies by consulate, exchange rate, and UMA value (recalculated each January). Not a single national rule.
TR via savings: approximately ~USD 70,000 avg over 12 months (UMA-based, same caveats)
Real estate ≥$450k MX OR investment ≥$225k MX
PR via income: approximately ~USD 7,100/mo for 6 months (UMA-based) OR savings ~USD 280,000 avg over 12 months — PR only for retirees at consulates. Same UMA/FX caveats.
After 4 years TR, or 2 years TR if married to Mexican citizen/PR
Standard docs: passport, photo, application, fee, supporting statements
Minors need birth certificate and parents' IDs
benefits: Fast: card in ≤4 weeks
Low cost and maintenance (renew every 1-4 years)
Banking/ID access
RESICO tax regime: ~1-2.5% on gross up to ~$200k for contractors/rents
Large expat ecosystem, high quality of life, major air connectivity
PR non-expiring with clear path to citizenship
sources: https://www.gob.mx/inm — Mexican National Institute of Migration (INM)
